title: Mahlanya Fauna Species
description: Schema for fauna species data used by the bioacoustic and ecology simulation pipelines. Extends the pipeline/history/data/ pattern (array-of-objects JSON with string IDs as foreign keys). Each species entry feeds into the Lotka-Volterra predator-prey ODE system and the biome distribution sampler in pipeline/audio/build_bioacoustic_library.py.

species.description: Catalogue of all simulated fauna species. Order is not significant; the simulation resolves predator/prey relationships by ID lookup.

biome_zone.description: Eswatini biome zone identifier. highveld: 1200–1800 m granite plateau. middleveld: 600–1200 m mixed bushveld. lowveld: 150–600 m savanna/thornveld. riparian: river corridors regardless of altitude.

active_period.description: Coarse time-of-day activity window used by the audio and NPC spawning systems.

lotka_volterra_params.title: Lotka-Volterra Parameters
lotka_volterra_params.description: Per-species coefficients for the Lotka-Volterra predator-prey ordinary differential equations. These values are consumed by pipeline/audio/build_bioacoustic_library.py to model population dynamics that affect ambient soundscape density.

r.description: Intrinsic growth rate (prey species) or intrinsic death rate (predator species) in the absence of the other. Units: per in-game month. Positive for prey, negative for predators that cannot sustain themselves without food.

alpha.description: Predation (interaction) coefficient. For a prey species: rate at which predator encounters reduce prey population per predator-prey pair. For a predator: rate at which prey encounters increase predator population per predator-prey pair. Units: per (individual * month).

species_entry.title: Fauna Species
species_entry.description: Complete ecological description of one fauna species. Foreign-key references to other species IDs must resolve within the same data file.

id.description: Unique species identifier used as a foreign key in prey/predators arrays and audio asset manifests. Convention: SPECIES_<CommonName> in snake_case.

common_name.description: Human-readable common name displayed in the in-game field guide.

scientific_name.description: Binomial nomenclature used for ecological validation and academic sourcing.

biome_zones.description: Biome zones where this species is found. The spawn sampler will only place the species in tiles whose biome_zone attribute matches one of these values.

altitude_min_m.description: Minimum altitude (metres above sea level) at which the species is found. Used to clip biome_zones placement to topographically valid tiles.

altitude_max_m.description: Maximum altitude (metres above sea level) at which the species is found.

active_hours.description: Time-of-day windows during which this species is active. Drives audio layer scheduling and NPC visibility.

prey.description: Species IDs that this species hunts. Empty array for herbivores and detritivores. Values must resolve to IDs present in the same species array.

predators.description: Species IDs that hunt this species. Empty array for apex predators. Values must resolve to IDs present in the same species array.
